ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、印象的なパイルバンカーを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場！
• 武器の内容は「RF-025 SCUDDER」「PB-033M ASHMEAD」「BML-G1/P32DUO-03」「SONGBIRDS」。
• 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
• 左手武器「PB-033M ASHMEAD」には射出状態を再現可能な差し替えパーツが付属。
en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON" items are commercialized in the "30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.
Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly" and "custom play," a group of weapons including an impressive pile bunker is now available as an optional parts set!
• Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
• The left hand weapon "PB-033M ASHMEAD" comes with replacement parts that can reproduce the ejection state.
